channel_details.title: Channel Details
channel_details.description: Primary broadcast channel configuration including name, category, and operational parameters.

stream_source.title: Stream Source (HLS Pull)
stream_source.description: Primary live HTTPS stream manifest URL delivering HLS segments (.m3u8). Must be publicly reachable or authenticated via query token.

backup_stream_source.title: Backup Stream Source
backup_stream_source.description: Failover stream URL used automatically if the primary ingest encounters uninterrupted packet loss or latency spikes.

bandwidth_cap.title: Bandwidth Cap
bandwidth_cap.description: Maximum outbound bitrate allocated to the channel stream across CDN edges.

age_rating.title: Age Rating & Child Protection
age_rating.description: Content classification tag. Viewers under 18 or in Kids Mode are strictly restricted from adult-rated broadcasts.

adult_content_flag.title: Adult Content Designation
adult_content_flag.description: Explicit flag indicating mature themes. Requires verified provider credentials and restricts delivery to age-verified accounts.

rights_licence.title: Licence & Territory Distribution
rights_licence.description: Contractual evidence of broadcast distribution rights for designated geographic regions and validity timeframes.

test_stream.title: Test Stream Validation
test_stream.description: Private staging playback verifying manifest syntax, keyframe cadence, and audio/video sync before public broadcast.
test_stream.example: Automated verification passes before review ticket generation

earnings_settlement.title: Earnings & Settlement
earnings_settlement.description: Earned revenue computed from verified stream watch sessions and settled in accordance with your signed agreement.
earnings_settlement.example: Settled according to your agreement terms

trending_promotion.title: Trending Promotion
trending_promotion.description: Promoted placement on the viewer home and trending rails, transparently badged with a 'Sponsored' tag.

schedule_slot.title: Schedule Slot & Playout
schedule_slot.description: Pre-scheduled broadcast programme window. Consecutive items must be queued back-to-back without overlapping conflicts.

two_step_verification.title: Account Two-Step Verification
two_step_verification.description: Enhanced security requirement using authenticator TOTP codes to safeguard portal access and sensitive channel controls.
two_step_verification.example: Required for channel publishing and payout requests
